themes.title: Far-right leaders face legal and political challenges
themes.blurb: Across multiple countries, far-right leaders are confronting legal troubles and political setbacks. Marine Le Pen's conviction in France, Reform UK's financial scandals, and Vox's internal controversies highlight a transnational pattern of legal and political pressure on right-wing movements.
